narwhal.description: Narwhal image by registry digest: the controller and the routers

runAsGroup.description: The controller's group ID, which owns the run directories

nodeSelector.description: The node labels the controller pod needs

directEngines.description: Engines that start directly from their image, with no launch plan or attestation, as direct_values derives them

backend.description: Backend whose direct start rendered the command

count.description: Engines in the fleet; a disaggregated fleet needs a prefill and a decode engine

command.description: The engine command the backend's direct start renders

env.description: Variables the engine process needs beyond the image's environment

port.description: Port each engine listens on in its pod

resources.description: Each engine's CPU and memory; the command's thread count follows the CPU limit

modelMount.description: Where each engine pod mounts the model volume

sharedMount.description: Where each engine pod mounts the directory every engine of the fleet shares

size.description: Requested size of the shared claim

shared.description: The ReadWriteMany claim every engine shares, for the backend's KV handoff files

size.description: Requested size of the state volume, such as 10Gi

claimName.description: The state claim's name, which the controller gives the engines and gate Jobs

size.description: Requested size of the lease volume, such as 10Gi

fleet.description: Fleet file path on the state volume

storageClassName.description: StorageClass of each router's own volume

size.description: Size of each router's own volume
Requested size of the data claim, such as 20Gi

admin.description: The Secret that holds the Grafana admin login

size.description: Requested size of the data claim, such as 20Gi

anonymous.description: Let anyone who reaches Grafana view the dashboards without signing in

fleet.description: The fleet label of every series Prometheus scrapes; empty for the release name

alertmanagerUrl.description: Alertmanager that Prometheus sends alerts to; without one, alerts show only on the Prometheus alerts page

modelVolumeSources.description: The model volume sources a fleet may use

modelHostPathPrefixes.description: Host directories a fleet's hostPath model volume may be or lie in; empty turns hostPath off

modelNfsServers.description: The NFS servers a fleet's nfs model volume may name; empty turns nfs off

modelCsiDrivers.description: The CSI drivers a fleet's csi model volume may use; empty turns csi off

runtimeClassNames.description: The RuntimeClasses a pod in the namespace may name; empty allows only the default runtime

fleet.description: The NarwhalFleet the chart installs, as its spec; leave it out to apply the fleet another way

images.description: The images the fleet runs besides the engine's, each by registry digest

narwhal.description: The Narwhal image: the controller, routers, gate Jobs and attestation sidecars

fabric.description: The image the fabric Jobs run ib_write_bw from

image.description: The engine image by registry digest

file.description: For an engine that serves one model file, its path in the model volume

modelVolume.description: The volume that serves the staged checkpoint to every engine pod, read-only. Set exactly one source.

persistentVolumeClaim.description: A PersistentVolumeClaim in the fleet's namespace

readOnly.description: Always true: engines read the model and never write it

hostPath.description: A directory on every engine node. The controller refuses it unless the cluster admin lists hostPath in the narwhal chart's modelVolumeSources and a prefix that holds it in modelHostPathPrefixes, which is empty by default.

path.description: The directory's normalised absolute path on the node

type.description: Directory: the kubelet refuses a path that is not an existing directory

nfs.description: An NFS export. The controller refuses it unless the cluster admin lists nfs in the narwhal chart's modelVolumeSources and its server in modelNfsServers.

server.description: The NFS server's host name or address

readOnly.description: Always true: engines read the model and never write it

csi.description: A CSI ephemeral volume. The controller refuses it unless the cluster admin lists csi in the narwhal chart's modelVolumeSources and its driver in modelCsiDrivers.

readOnly.description: Always true: engines read the model and never write it

resources.description: The device plugins' extended resources, and the engine pods' RuntimeClass

gpu.description: The GPU device plugin's extended resource name, <domain>/<name>

rdma.description: The RDMA device plugin's extended resource name, which hands each engine pod one HCA

runtimeClassName.description: The RuntimeClass of nodes whose default container runtime exposes no GPUs

ports.description: The ports each engine pod serves on

items.description: One engine: the node its pod runs on, in role order, so the first entry is engine-1. Two engines may share a node.

fabricInterface.description: The network interface that carries the engine's KV transfers

rdma.description: The RDMA port settings of a ucx_rdma engine

gidIndex.description: The GID index of the HCA port

roceMode.description: v2 or v1 for RoCE, or infiniband for a native InfiniBand port

apiKeySecret.description: The Secret that holds the engines' API key. Name a new Secret to rotate the key.

launch.description: More launch inputs of the engine backend, as the variables discovery reads, such as NARWHAL_ENGINE_BACKEND or NARWHAL_TRANSFER_NET_DEVICES. A name another field of the fleet sets, or that names a credential, is refused.

slo.description: The fleet's service-level objective, in seconds

routerOverheadS.description: The router's own share of each request

firstTokenMarginS.description: Seconds the first-token deadline adds to the calibrated candidate

prefillLens.description: The prompt lengths of the prefill sweep

decodeInputLens.description: The input lengths of the decode sweep

decodeConcurrency.description: The concurrency levels of the decode sweep

samples.description: Samples per group, at least the 100 that preflight accepts

observationTimeoutS.description: Seconds calibration waits for one observation

workload.description: The workload the fabric budget sizes each edge for

handoffsPerS.description: Peak remote KV handoffs per second on each directed edge, for each source cache group

transferBudgetS.description: Seconds in which one burst must transfer

testPort.description: The TCP port the fabric test listens on

storageClassName.description: The storage class of each router's volume

size.description: The size of each router's volume

haproxy.description: The HAProxy load balancer in front of the routers

stages.description: One stage's limit, by stage name

until.description: The last stage to run; every stage by default

stopped.description: Stop the routers, HAProxy, engines and Jobs, keeping the volumes

retainRuns.description: Run directories kept, the current one included

enabled.description: Admit connections to the routers only from HAProxy, the gate Jobs, the other router and monitoring

monitoring.description: More NetworkPolicy peers that may reach the routers, such as a cluster Prometheus
